name: Providence Health Care Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at hospitals, care homes and a hospice in Vancouver. You might garden, run games and events, visit with people, help with pet visits, show people the way or work in the gift shop.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older for long-term care sites; 18 or older for acute care (hospitals). You must complete a free criminal record check and get a free yearly flu shot or wear a mask.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers can ask for a reference after 30 hours at long-term care sites.
duration: 1 to 3 hours a week for at least 4 or 6 months in a row, depending on the program
deadline_text: No deadline. Each site takes online applications; if no one contacts you in 6 to 8 weeks, apply again.
how_to_apply: Pick a site on the volunteer page (for example Holy Family Hospital, Mount Saint Joseph long-term care or a St. Vincent's site) and fill out its online form. List references like teachers or coaches. If chosen, you will be called for an interview.
notes: At 16 or 17 you can only volunteer at the long-term care sites. There is no shadowing or direct patient care. Most shifts are weekdays during work or school hours. The FAQ also says Public Health requires two COVID-19 shots for volunteers.
